emptyState: Select a service on the left to connect.

settings.webviewOnlyWarning: {{name}} has no official third-party file API, so it is shown as a web view instead of a file browser.
settings.redirectUriLabel: Register this exact address as the Redirect URI (callback URL) in the developer console:
settings.redirectUriHelp: The port number must match exactly. Click Connect after registering it.
settings.consoleHintDropbox: Dropbox App Console → your app → Settings tab → add under Redirect URIs.
settings.consoleHintGdrive: Google Cloud Console → Credentials → Create OAuth client ID: you must choose 'Web application' as the application type for the Authorized redirect URIs field to appear ('Desktop app' hides this field).
settings.consoleHintOnedrive: Azure Portal → App registrations → your app → Authentication → Add a platform → choose 'Web' and add the redirect URI.
settings.consoleHintNaver: Naver Developers → your application → API settings → add under Callback URL.
settings.consoleHintKakao: Kakao Developers → My Application → Kakao Login → add under Redirect URI.
settings.guideTitle: Complete these console steps in order before connecting:

guide.dropbox1: Create an app in the Dropbox App Console (API: Scoped access, Access: Full Dropbox)
guide.dropbox2: Settings tab → add the address below under Redirect URIs, then save
guide.dropbox3: Permissions tab → check files.metadata.read, files.content.read, files.content.write, then Submit (skipping this causes a 'missing_scope' error)
guide.dropbox4: After changing scopes, Disconnect the existing account and Connect again — old tokens keep the old scopes
guide.dropbox5: App key = Client ID, App secret = Client Secret (click Show to reveal)
guide.gdrive1: Enable the Google Drive API first — otherwise you'll get a 403 'API has not been used in project' error
guide.gdrive2: Credentials → Create OAuth client ID → application type MUST be 'Web application' ('Desktop app' hides the redirect URI field)
guide.gdrive3: Add the address below under Authorized redirect URIs
guide.gdrive4: Copy the Client ID / Client secret and paste them below
guide.gdrive5: OAuth consent screen (Audience) → add your own Google account under Test users (skipping this causes 'Access blocked')
guide.gdrive6: For personal use, publishing the app to Production is not required — test user registration is enough
guide.onedrive1: Azure Portal → App registrations → New registration (account type: personal Microsoft accounts only)
guide.onedrive2: Authentication → Add a platform → 'Web' → add the address below under Redirect URIs (http://127.0.0.1 is rejected — use http://localhost instead)
guide.onedrive3: Certificates & secrets → New client secret → copy the Value immediately (it can't be viewed again); under API permissions add Files.ReadWrite, offline_access, User.Read
guide.naver2: API settings → add the address below under Callback URL
guide.kakao2: Kakao Login → add the address below under Redirect URI
